roles.title: Junior Software Engineer
roles.description: Developed and deployed a backend module for a B2B digital payments platform, implementing CRUD REST endpoints, audit logging, and a postback integration to synchronize database operations across backend systems. Strengthened API security by addressing security testing findings through input validation and sanitization, preventing malformed and unsafe data from entering application workflows. Tested API endpoints and integration flows and shipped changes through Git-based merge requests across staging environments.

roles.title: Software / IT Support Engineer Intern
roles.description: Developed OTP and Standard Flight Report modules for a migrated aviation flight-information system, implementing REST endpoints, MVC controllers, and data-access logic. Rebuilt the legacy OTP report generator using FPDF, reducing document generation time from approximately 5 minutes to under 1 second while meeting CAA documentation standards. Designed and deployed a 3-node Proxmox high-availability cluster with quorum, node fencing, live LXC migration, and storage replication. Improved Lighthouse performance scores from approximately 30 to 70–100 across 26+ company web pages through asset optimization, caching, and removal of render-blocking resources.
